newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FCC in Indonesian property joint venture.
newsitem.headline: FCC in Indonesian property joint venture.

text.p: Property group First Capital Corp Ltd (FCC) said on Tuesday it had signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with PT Duta Angganda Realty (DAR) for a joint venture to develop a commercial project in Jakarta.
FCC said in a statement it and DAR would each hold 50 percent of the firm which would develop a 33,300 sq metre site at Jalan Jenderal Sudirman, in Jakarta's business district.
The venture would also acquire Chase Plaza, a 41,000 sq metre office complex on 11,800 sq m of land along the same road. The MOU is subject to execution within three months.
